title: Grounds for Processing Personal Data
text: A person may process personal data of a Data Principal only for a lawful purpose for which the Data Principal has given consent or for certain legitimate uses as specified under the Act.

title: Notice Requirement
text: Every request for consent shall be preceded or accompanied by a notice informing the Data Principal of the personal data to be collected, purpose of processing, how rights may be exercised, and complaint mechanisms.

title: Consent and Purpose Limitation
text: Consent of the Data Principal shall be free, specific, informed, unconditional, and unambiguous with a clear affirmative action. Data shall only be processed to the extent necessary for the specified purpose.

title: General Obligations: Accuracy and Accountability
text: A Data Fiduciary shall maintain accurate, complete, and consistent personal data, implement internal audit logs, and establish verifiable technical accountability mechanisms.

title: Reasonable Security Safeguards
text: A Data Fiduciary shall protect personal data in its possession or under its control by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breaches, including masking, encryption, and tokenization before external transfer.

title: Data Erasure and Retention Limitation
text: A Data Fiduciary shall erase personal data upon the Data Principal withdrawing consent or as soon as it is reasonable to assume that the specified purpose is no longer being served, whichever is earlier.

title: Processing of Children's Personal Data
text: A Data Fiduciary shall, before processing any personal data of a child (under 18 years), obtain verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian and shall not undertake tracking, behavioral monitoring, or targeted advertising directed at children.

title: Transfer of Personal Data Outside India
text: The Central Government may restrict the transfer of personal data by a Data Fiduciary for processing to such countries or territories outside India as notified. Strict data localization and transfer safeguards apply.
